messages.subject: temp.stan gets stuck
parts:
There is a test Stan model under src/models/temp.stan. It gets stuck.
The file has 2 blocks: transformed data and an empty model block. The
transformed data block has a bunch of matrix operations, but nothing
else.

To run the test associated with it, type:
make test/models/temp

Before I started looking into it, I figured I should bring it up. If
someone wants to take a look before I get to it, let me know.



Daniel

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] temp.stan gets stuck
parts:
There are no parameters in the model. So
there's no gradient, so the parameters can't
move.

We need to flag this somewhere and raise
an error. Either in the command (look at the
model and make sure num params > 0) or in
the two samplers.

- Bob
